blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Tax rates come in two main shapes. A fixed rate is the same for everyone. For example, you pay 20% on every pound of profit — the same 20% whether you earn £10,000 or £10 million.

A progressive rate gets higher as the amount gets bigger. You might pay 20% on the first slice of income, 30% on the next slice, and 40% on everything above a certain level.

Fixed rates are simpler. Progressive rates try to be fairer: people who earn more pay a higher percentage. Most income taxes are progressive; most sales taxes are fixed. If you know whether a rate is fixed or progressive, you understand most of the tax.

items.q: What are the two main shapes of tax rates?
items.why: "Tax rates come in two main shapes." — fixed e progressive.

items.q: With a fixed rate, how much do you pay?
items.why: "A fixed rate is the same for everyone."

items.q: Under a progressive rate, what happens as the amount gets bigger?
items.why: "A progressive rate gets higher as the amount gets bigger."

items.q: The text suggests that a person who earns more under a progressive rate…
items.why: Inferência: "people who earn more pay a higher percentage" — logo, quem ganha mais paga mais em %.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: one question — fixed or progressive — tells you a lot about a tax
all taxes are exactly the same
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que saber se é fixa ou progressiva já explica quase tudo sobre o imposto.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry explicando a um colega novo. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, let me show you how this works on a real payslip. Look here. This person earns three thousand pounds a month. The tax is not one number for the whole amount. It comes in slices.

See the first slice? The first thousand pounds is taxed at twenty percent. That is low. The next thousand is taxed at thirty percent. And the top part, the last thousand, pays forty percent. So the rate goes up slice by slice, not because the person is special, but because the money is higher up.

This is a progressive rate. It is a bit more work to read, but it tries to be fairer. People who earn more pay a higher percentage on the top slice.

If it were a fixed rate, it would be much simpler. You would just take twenty percent of everything and stop. Same rate for a small salary and a big one. Most sales taxes work like that. But income tax here is progressive, so always read it slice by slice.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Harry showing to the new colleague?
options: How a progressive rate works on a payslip
How to open a bank account
items.why: "let me show you how this works on a real payslip" — ele explica a alíquota progressiva.

items.q: How is the tax on the payslip calculated?
options: As one number for the whole amount
Only at the end of the year
items.why: "It comes in slices."

items.q: What rate does the top slice pay?
items.why: "the top part, the last thousand, pays forty percent."

items.q: Harry says the rate goes up slice by slice. This suggests that…
options: the person is being punished for being special
the higher money is taxed at a higher rate, not the person
the tax is a fixed rate
items.why: Inferência: "not because the person is special, but because the money is higher up."

items.q: Why does Harry mention a fixed rate at the end?
options: To show it would be simpler than the progressive one
To say income tax uses it
To say it pays forty percent
items.why: Inferência: ele compara — "If it were a fixed rate, it would be much simpler."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Everyone pays a fixed rate of 20%." A fixed rate is…
options: a rate that changes each month
a rate only for rich people
items.why: Fixed rate = alíquota fixa, igual para todos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "With a ___ rate, people who earn more pay a higher percentage."
items.why: Progressive rate = alíquota progressiva, sobe com o valor.

items.q: "The first slice of income is taxed at 20%." A slice of income is…
options: a part or band of the income
items.why: Slice = faixa de renda, uma parte do total.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "People who ___ more money pay more tax."
items.why: To earn = ganhar (dinheiro).

items.q: "The top rate starts above a certain level." Here level means…
items.why: Level = nível, um ponto/valor a partir do qual a regra muda.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões sobre impostos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you break down the tax slice by slice?" To break down means to…
items.why: Break down = detalhar, dividir em partes menores.

items.q: "The finance team will sign off on the new rate." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente.

items.q: "The government will roll out the new tax in April." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar, colocar em prática.

items.q: "Some people pushed back on the higher rate." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "Please work out the tax on this salary." To work out means to…
items.why: Work out = calcular, chegar ao resultado.
